summary: Read-only character attachment and contact geometry observations keyed by character and topology revision.
rate: On demanded character geometry or topology revision changes, never a continuous full-mesh read.
x-boundary: Scene adapter extracts plain head-space arrays or buffer references; no Three objects cross into domain state. Demand only while a consumer needs contact or attachment geometry.
x-frame: Read bind-pose head-space geometry, frame and down vector. Cap geometry is a one-time density seed only; skin Head joint owns rigid attachment.
x-reference: Read-only baseline references use a separately keyed base-game archive view through the same resolver and native decoders, excluding replacements and XL overlays. Reference cap geometry and masks seed authored scalp-space maps once; the shown V and installed route are untouched.
